claim_type: explicit mixed-class counterexamples with exact Ramanujan Cayley witness
limitations: Exact certificates cover one Ramanujan witness, not a census of the class.
No claim about spectra for primes greater than 7.
The Rayleigh vector is a lower-bound/eigenspace cross-check only; the upper spectral bound is supplied by exact positive-definiteness and independent exact spectral factorization.
provenance: Previously published finding; independently reassessed on 2026-09-30 with a scientific repair to the proof/reproducibility files.
record_title: Central-unipotent 7-lifts in SL(2,q) are mixed: disconnected Borel family plus exact Ramanujan member in SL(2,7)
